wholePhysicalScope: The named OpenStreetMap way 583441451 fixes the 34-corner main-house footprint. Damien Linnane’s October 2014 CC0 photograph establishes the northwest projecting brick gables, decorated trim, paired upper windows, green corrugated roofs and open verandas.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the projecting brick gables, attached ranges, corrugated roofs and open verandas. Window detail and rail fretwork simplify with distance.
limitations: October 2014 exterior of the principal house and its attached ranges. Detached farm buildings and interiors are outside scope.
The northwest elevation is based on the cleared photograph. Rear and side elevations, roof joins, absolute heights and fine decorative joinery are estimates.
Original terrain samples are preserved. Foundation and entrance step heights use the original grade near the photographed northwest elevation.
